title: feat: add observability consumption paths
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a compact Platform & Usage section for Paid Pollen, Quest Pollen, requests, and selected-period totals across four additive product paths.
- Defines BYOP and BYOM as independent dimensions, including the BYOP + BYOM overlap without double-counting.
- Renames Community Models to BYOM — Community Models and Core API to Direct API while preserving dashboard UIDs.
- Updates the visual implementation plan and observability guidance to match the new attribution contract.

Validation:
- Production Tinybird read-only 30-day query: 0.023s, 145,188 rows, 5.81 MB.
- Grafana provisioning/runtime check: 17 dashboards, 5 active at root, 12 legacy, no provisioning errors.
- `npm run check`, Biome, JSON parsing, HTML script parsing, panel-ID/grid checks, and `git diff --check` passed.

No deployment, Tinybird promotion, or secret mutation is included.

gist.headline: Four paths, one garden
gist.blurb: The observability garden got clearer labels and fewer overlapping footprints. Paid Pollen, Quest Pollen, requests, and product-path totals now have a compact place to bloom.
gist.summary: Rebuilt Platform & Usage observability dashboards to track Paid Pollen, Quest Pollen, requests, and selected-period totals across four additive product paths, with BYOP and BYOM counted independently and without double-counting their overlap.
gist.impact: Operators can now inspect Direct API, BYOM, BYOP, and BYOP + BYOM usage with preserved dashboard UIDs and clearer attribution in Grafana.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy observability garden with four clearly labeled paths leading to small glowing dashboards: Direct API, BYOM, BYOP, and their shared overlap. Polli, wearing tiny analyst glasses and carrying a clipboard, checks that the overlapping flower bed is counted once while code-plants and Pollen jars represent usage totals.
